metadata.title: Entra-PIM
metadata.description: PowerShell module for managing Microsoft Entra PIM (Privileged Identity Management) role activations and deactivations through an interactive console experience. Supports Entra ID roles, Azure Resource roles, and Groups PIM with browser-based authentication. Features automatic step-up MFA handling, one-command activation/deactivation, and auto-installation of dependencies. Cross-platform compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux. Just run Start-EntraPIM - works out of the box with no configuration, or bring your own app registration for full control.
